name: Headwind Simulator
prompt:
"Build a 'Macroeconomic Headwind Simulator' for the executive team. The base dataset is the current fiscal year's Projected Revenue, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), and Net Profit Margin broken down by product line.

The UI must feature:

A clean, minimalist layout with three massive KPI cards: Target Net Profit, Simulated Net Profit, and Delta ($ Variance).

A sidebar containing three macro levers (sliders): 'Inflation Spike' (0% to 10%), 'Supply Chain Tariff' (0% to 25%), and 'Interest Rate Hike' (0% to 5%).

Moving any slider must instantly recalculate the Simulated Net Profit using a compound erosion formula and update a waterfall chart showing exactly where the revenue leaks are occurring across product lines."

thought_process.interpretation: An executive-level 'Macroeconomic Headwind Simulator' designed to visualize the impact of external economic stressors on net profit margins across product lines. The app adopts an 'Executive Strategic Overview' archetype, focusing on high-level KPIs and an interactive waterfall visualization for root-cause analysis of margin erosion.
assumed_from_scratch: Waterfall Chart implementation using Recharts BarChart with transparent offsets
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'waterfall_chart.md' skill and 'slider_control.md' skill would standardize these common interactive simulation elements.
